CHOOSER.TITLE: Where will this campaign go?
CHOOSER.SUBTITLE: Only the channels connected to this account show up here.
CHOOSER.EMPTY: No campaign channel is connected to this account yet.

HINTS.EMAIL: Rich content, with editor and templates.
HINTS.WHATSAPP_OFFICIAL: Template approved by Meta. For people who have not talked to you yet.
HINTS.WHATSAPP_API: Free text and media, one message at a time, at a safe pace.
HINTS.SMS: Short text that reaches any phone.

LIST.TITLE: Campaign
LIST.SUBTITLE: Every connected channel in one place. Create, schedule and follow each send.
LIST.LOAD_ERROR: Some campaigns could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
LIST.EMPTY_SUBTITLE: Click New campaign to create the first one.

AUDIENCES.TITLE: Audience
AUDIENCES.SUBTITLE: People you imported for campaigns and the channels you can reach each of them on.
AUDIENCES.LOAD_ERROR: The audiences could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
AUDIENCES.EMPTY_TITLE: You don't have an audience yet
AUDIENCES.EMPTY_SUBTITLE: An audience is a list of people. Upload a spreadsheet to create the first one.
AUDIENCES.CONFIRM_TEXT: Only the list is deleted. Contacts, companies, conversations and campaign results stay.
AUDIENCES.IN_USE: This audience is used by campaigns that have not finished: {campaigns}. Wait for them to finish or cancel them first.
AUDIENCES.ERROR: Could not delete the audience now.

NEW_AUDIENCE.TITLE: New audience
NEW_AUDIENCE.SUBTITLE: Upload the spreadsheet. We find the columns, the channels and the companies.
NEW_AUDIENCE.FROM_CAMPAIGN: You are creating an audience for the campaign "{name}". When you save it, we take you back to it.
NEW_AUDIENCE.FROM_CAMPAIGN_UNTITLED: You are creating an audience for the campaign you started. When you save it, we take you back to it.
NEW_AUDIENCE.NAME_HINT: Only your team sees it. Use a name that reminds you who is on the list.
NEW_AUDIENCE.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Car insurance renewals in October
NEW_AUDIENCE.FILE_HINT: CSV or Excel. Name and mobile or email; company and other columns are welcome.
NEW_AUDIENCE.CHECKING_HINT: This takes a few seconds. Nothing is saved yet.
NEW_AUDIENCE.REVIEW_SUBTITLE: Check before saving. Nothing goes into your contacts until you save.

COLUMNS.TITLE: Columns found
COLUMNS.CHOOSE_TITLE: Which column has each piece of data?
COLUMNS.CHOOSE_HINT: We could not tell for sure. Choose the column of each one, or None.
COLUMNS.NEED_CONTACT: Choose a mobile or an email column.
COLUMNS.OTHER_HINT: Kept to use in the message

CHANNELS.TITLE: Where you can reach these people
CHANNELS.HINT: Turned on by what the spreadsheet has. Turn a channel off if this audience is not for it.
CHANNELS.NO_EMAIL_HINT: The spreadsheet has no valid email.
CHANNELS.NO_PHONE_HINT: The spreadsheet has no valid mobile.
CHANNELS.ERROR: Could not change it now. Try again.
CHANNELS.IN_USE: Campaigns still send to this audience on this channel: {campaigns}. Wait for them to finish or cancel them first.

PEOPLE.NAME: Name
PEOPLE.LEFT_OUT: These rows are left out. Fix them and upload again when you want.

REASONS.NO_VALID_ROWS: No row has a valid mobile or email
REASONS.ROW_LIMIT: The spreadsheet has more rows than allowed

REFUSED.TITLE: No row can be used
REFUSED.HINT: Every row has a problem. Check the reasons, change the columns or upload another spreadsheet.

COMPANIES.TITLE: Companies
COMPANIES.HINT: The {column} column has each contact's company.
COMPANIES.OFF_HINT: No company will be created or linked.
COMPANIES.ERROR: Could not change it now. Try again.

NEW_AUDIENCE.SAVING_HINT: You can leave this page; saving continues.

FAILED.TITLE: The spreadsheet could not be read
FAILED.HINT: Upload it again. If it happens again, save it as CSV and try once more.

ERRORS.CREATE: Could not send the spreadsheet. Try again.
ERRORS.COLUMNS: Could not use these columns. Try again.
ERRORS.SAVE: Could not save the audience. Try again.

AUDIENCE.TITLE: Who will receive it
AUDIENCE.HINT: Choose an audience. The badges show where you can reach these people.
AUDIENCE.RETURNED: Done, we're back. The audience "{name}" was saved and is already selected.
AUDIENCE.EMPTY_TEXT: You don't have a list of people yet. Let's create the first one: just upload the spreadsheet. When you're done, we come back to this campaign.
AUDIENCE.NOT_FOUND: Didn't find who you're looking for?
AUDIENCE.NOT_FOUND_HINT: Create a new audience with a spreadsheet. Then we come back here.
AUDIENCE.LIVE_CHAT: Want an automatic message on your website, without a list of people?
AUDIENCE.LOAD_ERROR: The audiences could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

MESSAGE.CHANNELS_HINT: Only the channels connected to this account show up. The ones this audience lacks are unavailable.
MESSAGE.OLD_FLOW: Opens the form of this channel.
MESSAGE.CRM_NOTE: Whoever replies gets the tag {tag} on the CRM card.
MESSAGE.INBOX_HINT: Only inboxes that can send approved templates show up.
MESSAGE.TEMPLATE_EMPTY: This inbox has no approved template yet.
MESSAGE.MEDIA_LABEL: Link of the file shown at the top of the message
MESSAGE.PREVIEW_HINT: Preview with the first contact of the audience.
MESSAGE.PREVIEW_EMPTY: Choose a template to see the preview.

VARIABLES.TITLE: Where each part of the message comes from
VARIABLES.HINT: Columns kept in the audience can be used here.
VARIABLES.COVERAGE: {count} person is left out: missing {variables} | {count} people are left out: missing {variables}
VARIABLES.COVERAGE_OK: Everyone in the audience has these data.
VARIABLES.DEFAULT_HINT: With this text, nobody is left out because of it.

REVIEW.CRM: Whoever replies gets the tag {tag} on the card, along with other campaigns they already have.
REVIEW.PAST: Choose a future date and time.
REVIEW.EDIT_NOTE: Until it starts you can edit or cancel.
REVIEW.CONFIRM_NOW: Send now to {count} person? | Send now to {count} people?
REVIEW.CONFIRM_LATER: Schedule the send to {count} person? | Schedule the send to {count} people?
REVIEW.CONFIRM_LATER_TEXT: The send starts on {when}. Until then you can edit or cancel the campaign.

ERRORS.GENERIC: Could not create the campaign now. Your draft is kept.
ERRORS.WHATSAPP_CLOUD_REQUIRED: This inbox cannot send approved templates. Choose a WhatsApp Cloud inbox.
ERRORS.CHANNEL_NOT_IN_AUDIENCE: This audience has no mobile on for WhatsApp.
ERRORS.AUDIENCE_NOT_READY: This audience is not saved yet. Wait a moment and try again.
ERRORS.INVALID_VARIABLE_BINDINGS: Some part of the message has no valid source. Check where each part comes from.
ERRORS.INVALID_CAMPAIGN: The campaign could not be saved. Check the name and the template.
ERRORS.JOURNEY_DISABLED: The new campaign journey is off in this installation.
ERRORS.NOT_ALLOWED: You do not have permission to create campaigns.
